title: CARA: Conformally calibrated, drift-aware rotation averaging for global structure-from-motion (code and data)
description: Code, VGGT outputs on ETH3D, raw results, pre-registration and LaTeX sources for the CARA paper submitted to Image and Vision Computing. Code is released under the MIT licence. The files in data/ contain reference poses derived from the ETH3D benchmark and are subject to the ETH3D licence terms, not the MIT licence.
